◆ DPU_CFARProcHWA_StaticConfig

typedef struct DPU_CFARProcHWA_StaticConfig_t DPU_CFARProcHWA_StaticConfig

HWA CFAR static configuration.

The structure is used to hold the static configuration used for CFAR. The following condition must be satisfied:

   numRangeBins * numDopplerBins * sizeof(uint16_t) <= 64 KB (4 HWA memory banks)
